instagram.caption:
How to turn a paper to-do list into your day with ADHD (one photo) 📸

My lists lived everywhere: the fridge, my bag, sticky notes. And I still forgot the dentist.

1. Write the list the way you always do, on paper
2. Snap ONE photo of it
3. Every task lands in today's list, no retyping

Email my boss, book the dentist, buy groceries: all in my day in seconds, and the paper can finally go.

📌 Save this for your next brain dump, and send it to someone whose fridge is covered in lists.
💜 Try FOCO, link in bio.
